## Terraform Resource: kestra_reusable_inputs

Manages a Kestra Reusable Inputs block (EE): a named, namespace-scoped set of input definitions that flows reference via a `REUSABLE_INPUTS` input. Its YAML source is persisted by the API and round-tripped verbatim.

## Example usage

```hcl
# A reusable inputs block, referenced from flows via a REUSABLE_INPUTS input
resource "kestra_reusable_inputs" "environment" {
  reusable_inputs_id = "environment-selector"
  namespace          = "company.team"

  content = <<EOT
description: Shared environment selector for the data team's flows
inputs:
  - id: environment
    type: SELECT
    values:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    defaults: dev
EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The block YAML source: an optional `description` and the non-empty `inputs` list (any input type except another `REUSABLE_INPUTS`, which cannot be nested). Diffs are compared semantically, so a change that only reindents, reorders keys or edits comments produces no plan and the source persisted by the API keeps its previous formatting; change a value to push a reformatted source.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace the block is attached to. A block defined in a parent namespace is visible to (and overridable by) child namespaces.
- `reusable_inputs_id` (String) The reusable inputs block id — unique per (tenant, namespace).

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant id (EE). Defaults to the provider tenant when omitted; the value is captured at create time, so changing the provider tenant later does not retarget the block.

### Read-Only

- `revision` (Number) The block revision, bumped by the API on every save.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import kestra_reusable_inputs.environment {{tenant_id}}/{{namespace}}/{{reusable_inputs_id}}
```
